subject: Shiproom briefing: product roadmap readiness, timelines, and delivery risks
messages:
From: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Cc: Maple Health PM <maple-health-pm@maplehealth.com>, Susan Park <susan@maplehealth.com>
Date: Thu, 10 Dec 2026 09:15:00 -0800
Subject: Shiproom briefing: product roadmap readiness, timelines, and delivery risks

Team —

As discussed in leadership sync, QBR is next week and we need a concise shiproom brief focused on product/eng readiness, launch timelines, and the delivery risks that could impact the Maple Health integration (they're counting on a Jan 12th rollout). Please send a short status update and the current risk ledger by EOD today so I can consolidate for the exec pack. Key asks:

- Where are we against the December milestones (model latency improvement, dedicated inference rollout, and canary test plan)?
- Any blockers that could push the external rollout beyond Jan 12? If so, please indicate ETA and mitigation.
- Clear owner for each high/severe risk.

Attachments: please attach the snapshot and the risk ledger (spreadsheet). I'll include any external-facing notes for Maple Health in the QBR deck.

Thanks —
Sean Gallagher
Director, Sales Operations
Redwood Inference

(attachment stubs: 2026-12-10-shiproom-agenda.docx)

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Cc: Maple Health PM <maple-health-pm@maplehealth.com>, Susan Park <susan@maplehealth.com>
Date: Thu, 10 Dec 2026 11:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Shiproom briefing: product roadmap readiness, timelines, and delivery risks

Sean —

Attached is the current roadmap snapshot and the risk ledger (summary below). High level: we are broadly aligned with the internal December milestones but there are two engineering risks that need leadership attention if we are to meet the Jan 12 external rollout target for Maple Health.

Roadmap highlights:
- Latency improvements: baseline down 18% on average after kernel optimizations; can meet the 25% target with one more kernel patch planned for next week.
- Dedicated inference: infra provisioning complete in staging; smoke tests pass, but capacity autoscaler needs a config tweak (INF-9873).
- Canary plan: scheduled, with first 10% traffic feed to dedicated pool on 2026-12-20.

Top risks (from ledger):
1) Quantization regression on long-context prompts — severity: HIGH — owner: Karthik. Repro on one production test vector set (PROD-4210). Mitigation: rolling quantization rollback and patch candidate by 2026-12-14; temporary fallback to fp16 variant for Maple Health if needed.
2) Autoscaler misconfiguration causing capacity oscillation under burst — severity: MEDIUM-HIGH — owner: Marcus. Mitigation: lock autoscaler policy and add guardrail for the first 48h of external traffic.
3) Compliance docs for Maple Health (data retention SLA wording) — severity: MEDIUM — owner: Grace. ETA for legal review: 2026-12-17.

I've attached: 2026-12-10-roadmap-snapshot.pdf and shiproom-risk-ledger-20261210.xlsx. See drive folder for detailed test logs.

Laura Bennett
VP, Product
Redwood Inference

(attachment stubs: 2026-12-10-roadmap-snapshot.pdf, shiproom-risk-ledger-20261210.xlsx)

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 11 Dec 2026 08:37:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Shiproom briefing: product roadmap readiness, timelines, and delivery risks

Laura / team —

Quick follow-up on the quantization regression (INF-4210 / PROD-4210). Root cause: a fused attention kernel change introduced a precision edge-case for sequences > 8k tokens; failing vectors only show up in our long-context evals (Maple uses long medical transcripts). The candidate patch is ready, but it needs validation on the full regression suite and the long-context perf harness. I estimate validation and staging rollout will take until end-of-day 2026-12-14. That pushes the safe external rollout to no earlier than 2026-12-20 if we keep a strict validation gate. Options:

A) Proceed with Jan 12 as planned but carve out a temporary fallback for Maple Health to the fp16 model for long-context sessions (feature parity caveat).
B) Delay the Maple Health external rollout to 2026-12-20 to complete validation and avoid toggles in production.

Recommendation: take option B for safety; if sales needs to preserve Jan 12 for customer communications, we can do A with documented caveats and a clear rollback plan.

I'll own the fix and validation. Marcus: can you confirm autoscaler guardrails will be in place by 12/17 so we don't have compounding risks?

Karthik Iyer
Head of Engineering — Serving Runtime
Redwood Inference

(On Thu, 10 Dec 2026 at 11:02, Laura Bennett wrote: "Attached is the current roadmap snapshot and the risk ledger...")

From: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Cc: Maple Health PM <maple-health-pm@maplehealth.com>, Susan Park <susan@maplehealth.com>
Date: Sat, 12 Dec 2026 16:44:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Shiproom briefing: product roadmap readiness, timelines, and delivery risks

Thanks for the fast responses — useful and action-oriented. Quick summary for the QBR/exec deck and for Maple Health (cc'd):

- Status: Internal milestones mostly green; latency and dedicated infra in good shape pending one kernel patch validation and an autoscaler config guard.
- Key risk and decision: quantization regression on long-context (HIGH) — engineering recommends delaying external rollout to 2026-12-20 to finish validation.
- Sales-facing option: we can keep Jan 12 external date if Maple Health accepts a limited fp16 fallback for very long sessions (we should enumerate functional differences).

Action items (owners / ETAs):
- Karthik: complete validation + staging rollout candidate by 2026-12-14 (owner: karthik_iyer).
- Marcus: lock autoscaler policy and implement 48h guardrail by 2026-12-17 (owner: marcus_lin).
- Grace: finalize data retention and SLA wording for Maple Health by 2026-12-17 (owner: grace_oconnor).
- Laura: finalize the external-facing talking points and a risk slide for the QBR deck by 2026-12-15 (owner: laura_bennett).

Maple Health — Susan and team, our recommended path is to delay the external cutover to 2026-12-20 for a safer launch. If you need the Jan 12 cadence, we can provide a fallback plan and document the caveats. Can you confirm which option you prefer by COB Monday 2026-12-14?

I'll fold the confirmed approach into the QBR deck and shiproom notes.

Sean Gallagher
Director, Sales Operations
Redwood Inference

(attachments referenced: roadmap snapshot, risk ledger; share links in drive folder: https://drive.redwood.company/drive/folders/shiproom-2026-q4)
